name: repro-picker
description: Reproduces patient selection in the vaccine plan dialog against a copy of a test database.

steps.expr: (async () => { const d = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop(); const i = [...d.querySelectorAll('input')].find(x => x.type !== 'hidden'); i.focus(); i.value = 'zey'; i.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input', { bubbles: true })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); return d.innerText.slice(0, 600); })()

(async () => { const d = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop(); const b = [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => /Zeytin/.test(x.innerText)); if (!b) return 'no Zeytin button'; b.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); return d.innerText.slice(0, 900); })()
